text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been hearing more and more
rumors about a "Singer of Good Fortune" around town.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Those who hear that song are deeply moved,
and eventually cross paths with good fortune, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
A lot of kids in class have been talking about it, too.
An elusive, mysterious singer... Pretty exciting, right?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I'm so curious, maybe I'll go look for it right now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Howaah!
Are you folks looking for that singer too?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I wanted to share in some of that good fortune too, but I couldn't find them~... From what I heard, they were singing and playing guitar for that komainu statue over there, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"The Fortunate Singer"?
Oh, I've heard her singing
near the shop before!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I didn't see who it was, but she had a lovely singing voice~.
The lyrics were entirely about ramen though,
so I couldn't help but chuckle.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"A singer who captures everyone's hearts...
as an Umadol, I can't just overlook that☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I came all the way here thinking that, but they're nowhere to be found~?!
I wanna see them in unison with the seagulls too, Falco wants to see it~!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, struck out here too, huh!
I really thought they'd be here this time~.
choice_data_list: Didn't the rumor say she was singing on a swan boat?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, being free-spirited is great!
I have a feeling we're gonna get along.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I wanna meet her so bad~
The 'Singer of Good Fortune'!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ruby!
Ruby, do you know about the 'Singer of Fortune'?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Or maybe you haven't. You don't really seem like the type to care about rumors.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
While my view does not differ,
I happen to know the true identity of the person you seek.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Nobody at all? Why,
she is standing right in front of you."

Staring straight at Mr. C.B.,
Daiichi Ruby declares nonchalantly.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: No, I did think she was doing the exact same things as me, and going to places that looked awfully familiar, but...
choice_data_list: Can you sing the ramen song?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I can sing!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Which means............ it's me!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Right, right, I get it now~

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The weather's been so nice lately, you know?
Everyone seems to be having fun, and I just can't help but want to sing!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I was just humming whatever came to mind,
and that turned into a rumor...? Ahaha, I see!

It was a truly unexpected truth.
This is—
choice_data_list: I want to hear the song too!
I want to hear you sing too!
So it was right under our noses, huh.
It really was right under our noses, wasn't it?

text_block_list.text:
It was a truly unexpected truth.
This is—
choice_data_list: I want to hear the song too!
I want to hear you sing too!
So it was right under our noses, huh.
It really was right under our noses, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing.
I'm kind of in the mood to sing anyway!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Given my current mood... Alright, let's go with this song!
And—as just an ordinary girl, she watched over Mr. C.B. as she sang.

Unlike a live performance that captivates you with charisma,
this had a gentle, deeply touching charm
that resonated quietly in the heart.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's a wrap!
How was it? The "Singer of Fortune"?
choice_data_list: It was just as amazing as always! Right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I believe the quality of your singing has reached quite a high standard.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's wonderful!

And so, the search for the mysterious singer came to an end,
and I returned to the academy alongside a satisfied Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Disappointed that it was just me?
choice_data_list: That's not true! I had fun searching for singers too!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, me too!
It felt just like a treasure hunt, super exciting!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—I'm tellin' you~!
I really did see it!
The "Acrobatic Uma-Uma"!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~? You mean that one, right?
The one where if you make eye contact, it chases you to the ends of the earth and forces you to run beside it until your body rots away—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: What's that? Sounds fun! ...Alright, let's go catch it!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Acrobatic Uma-Uma!
If you're there, come on out!"
Just as the mystery of the singer seemed solved, Mr. C.B. leaped after the next puzzle. All I could do was chase frantically after her.
